notes: Code names are encoded with nicknamed (the nearest catalogued relation; there is no code-name relation in RELATIONS.md), and a code name names one product (firm InvFunc(nicknamed)). Start-menu, kernel and similar facts are class memberships. successor_of is functional (catalogue), so the 'no' about Windows Server 2003 holds before the delete and becomes unknown after it. The question 'the OS code-named Longhorn' is a placeholder individual given its code name.

bridge_refs.xp_whistler: Windows XP was code-named Whistler during development.
bridge_refs.vista_longhorn: Longhorn was the code name of Windows Vista.
